Travel Notice for Companion Animals

Travelers need to know that the Companion Animal Travel Desk is here to make pet travel smoother and calmer from check-in to arrival.

Our team reviews each care plan with attention to species, temperament, and comfort, so pets can travel in a way that suits their needs. The senior coordinator helps guide daily service choices, and that support keeps care steady when plans change. <<FACT F117>> If something goes wrong with your pet's journey, please keep all travel papers and speak with staff as soon as you can. <<FACT F110>> We will help you sort the next steps with clear, practical guidance.

For the best support, bring your companion to the desk early and share any comfort notes that may help the team. If you need help before departure, the Companion Animal Travel Desk is ready to assist you.
